correctness.rationale: The proof first converts antiferromagnetic energy to monochromatic-edge count and derives f≥3s from cubic cut degree; the n quadrilateral face parities prove f≥2 for the even twisted topology and classify all 2n equality configurations. The maximum independent sets provide the s=1 branch, and all remaining energies are bounded by affine functions of s whose minimum occurs at endpoints. A twisted three-state transfer matrix exactly computes every saturation-field ground multiplicity, with all boundary cases n≥3 and real h treated. Two structurally distinct runnable scripts checked all spin configurations up to n=9 and transfer values through n=50. No finite computation is substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: The field-driven topology-sensitive defect costs a constant coupling threshold for every even finite Möbius ladder, but disappears for odd ladders. This exact infinite-family magnetic response includes both all-field energies/magnetizations and coexisting-state enumeration with nonzero limiting saturation entropy. The effect is finite-size and not incorrectly promoted to an extensive magnetization plateau or finite-temperature transition.
